llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何人工智能技术，仅描述水凝胶与牺牲材料制造心形结构的实验过程。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration into any bioprinting stage; purely experimental fabrication without computational modeling or optimization.

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate a heart-shaped scaffold with internal channels for tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: A composite hydrogel and sacrificial material were co-printed to create the desired geometry.
summary_en.result: The heart-shaped structure was successfully printed with open internal channels.
summary_en.validation: SEM imaging and mechanical testing confirmed structural integrity and channel formation.
